boundary: No utterance, transcript, reference, gold or model output text is printed or persisted: the receipt holds counts, rates, ids and hashes; note text is held in memory for the counts and dropped.
mode_rule: applied in order, first match wins: LOOP if the 6-gram repetition share >= 0.20; TRANSCRIPT if the note re-emits >= 0.50 of the same window's direct-arm transcript 4-gram set; ENUMERATION if it has >= 10 non-empty lines (twice the E41 line bound); PROSE otherwise
